{
  "schemaVersion": "loop-commissioning-input.v1",
  "commissioning": {
    "id": "milestone-loop-template-source.v1",
    "targetBranch": "master",
    "baseCommit": "0f4ab3e5ef39bda07d6e77356ad53fca9136cdd5",
    "profile": "readiness"
  },
  "sources": {
    "configPath": "tools/milestone-orchestrator/config/default.json",
    "invariantSuitePath": "tools/milestone-orchestrator/config/invariant-suite.json",
    "scopePolicyPath": "tools/milestone-orchestrator/config/verification-scope-policy.json",
    "immutableContractLockPath": "evals/immutable-contract-lock.json",
    "immutableContractLockSha256": "d1166088b00c54af65e8654188adc58a3cabd9d7908820809fe66af28c933050"
  },
  "objective": "Commission the generic verification lifecycle for the milestone-loop template repository.",
  "exclusions": [
    "No frozen authority, calibration, readiness meaning, verifier deadline, or exact command changes.",
    "No product implementation, placeholder replacement, historical-record rewrite, or worked-example migration."
  ],
  "focusedCommands": [
    {
      "id": "test-invariants",
      "argv": ["pnpm", "test:invariants"],
      "tiers": ["iteration", "candidate", "milestone"],
      "expectedArtifactKinds": ["invariant-suite-report"]
    },
    {
      "id": "test-unit-fast",
      "argv": ["pnpm", "test:unit:fast"],
      "tiers": ["candidate", "milestone"],
      "expectedArtifactKinds": [
        "fast-unit-vitest-report",
        "unit-partition-report"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "test-unit-migrations",
      "argv": ["pnpm", "test:unit:migrations"],
      "tiers": ["milestone"],
      "expectedArtifactKinds": [
        "migration-unit-vitest-report",
        "unit-partition-report"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "test-orchestrator",
      "argv": ["pnpm", "test:orchestrator"],
      "tiers": ["candidate", "milestone"],
      "expectedArtifactKinds": ["orchestrator-vitest-report"]
    },
    {
      "id": "format-check",
      "argv": ["pnpm", "format:check"],
      "tiers": ["candidate", "milestone"],
      "expectedArtifactKinds": ["format-report"]
    },
    {
      "id": "lint",
      "argv": ["pnpm", "lint"],
      "tiers": ["candidate", "milestone"],
      "expectedArtifactKinds": ["lint-report"]
    },
    {
      "id": "lint-architecture",
      "argv": ["pnpm", "lint:architecture"],
      "tiers": ["candidate", "milestone"],
      "expectedArtifactKinds": ["architecture-report"]
    },
    {
      "id": "typecheck",
      "argv": ["pnpm", "typecheck"],
      "tiers": ["candidate", "milestone"],
      "expectedArtifactKinds": ["typecheck-report"]
    },
    {
      "id": "build",
      "argv": ["pnpm", "build"],
      "tiers": ["candidate", "milestone"],
      "expectedArtifactKinds": ["build-report"]
    },
    {
      "id": "domain-construction-standard",
      "argv": ["pnpm", "verify:domain-construction-standard"],
      "tiers": ["milestone"],
      "expectedArtifactKinds": [
        "domain-construction-standard-proof",
        "independent-domain-construction-standard-proof",
        "domain-construction-standard-vitest-report",
        "domain-construction-standard-worker-parity-report",
        "playwright-report",
        "browser-diagnostics",
        "domain-construction-standard-verification-report"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "domain-resources",
      "argv": ["pnpm", "verify:domain-resources"],
      "tiers": ["milestone"],
      "expectedArtifactKinds": ["domain-resources-report"]
    },
    {
      "id": "domain-networks",
      "argv": ["pnpm", "verify:domain-networks"],
      "tiers": ["milestone"],
      "expectedArtifactKinds": ["domain-networks-report"]
    },
    {
      "id": "domain-planning",
      "argv": ["pnpm", "verify:domain-planning"],
      "tiers": ["milestone"],
      "expectedArtifactKinds": ["domain-planning-report"]
    },
    {
      "id": "domain-entitlement",
      "argv": ["pnpm", "verify:domain-entitlement"],
      "tiers": ["milestone"],
      "expectedArtifactKinds": ["domain-entitlement-report"]
    },
    {
      "id": "domain-entitlement-standard",
      "argv": ["pnpm", "verify:domain-entitlement-standard"],
      "tiers": ["milestone"],
      "expectedArtifactKinds": ["domain-entitlement-standard-report"]
    },
    {
      "id": "domain-development",
      "argv": ["pnpm", "verify:domain-development"],
      "tiers": ["milestone"],
      "expectedArtifactKinds": ["domain-development-report"]
    },
    {
      "id": "domain-simulation",
      "argv": ["pnpm", "verify:domain-simulation"],
      "tiers": ["milestone"],
      "expectedArtifactKinds": ["domain-simulation-report"]
    },
    {
      "id": "domain-browser",
      "argv": ["pnpm", "verify:domain-browser"],
      "tiers": ["milestone"],
      "expectedArtifactKinds": ["domain-browser-report"]
    }
  ],
  "requiredProtectedPaths": [
    ".agent/completed/loop-recommissioning-verification.json",
    ".agent/readiness-profile-activated.json",
    ".agent/verification-manifest.json",
    "AGENTS.md",
    "PROJECT_GOAL.md",
    "evals/ACCEPTANCE.md",
    "evals/HIDDEN_VALIDATION_PROTOCOL.md",
    "evals/acceptance-manifest.json",
    "evals/immutable-contract-lock.json",
    "package.json",
    "pnpm-lock.yaml",
    "scripts/verify.mjs",
    "tools/milestone-orchestrator/config/default.json",
    "tools/milestone-orchestrator/config/invariant-suite.json",
    "tools/milestone-orchestrator/config/source-commissioning-input.json",
    "tools/milestone-orchestrator/config/verification-scope-policy.json"
  ],
  "requiredInvariantSuiteId": "milestone-loop-core-invariants.v1",
  "scopePolicyId": "milestone-loop-shadow-scope-policy.v1",
  "exactVerification": {
    "argv": ["pnpm", "verify"],
    "requiresNoArguments": true,
    "profileSource": "package-default",
    "selectedByOverride": false
  },
  "reconciliationPolicy": {
    "id": "milestone-loop-source-reconciliation.v1",
    "nextProposalPath": ".agent/next-milestone.json",
    "requiredReviewChecks": [
      "completeCommitLineage",
      "protectedIntegrity",
      "noFabricatedHistory",
      "commandOwnedEvidenceValidity",
      "verificationTierNonAuthority",
      "invariantSuiteQuality",
      "selectorShadowOnlyEnforcement",
      "telemetryNonSemanticBehavior",
      "artifactContainmentAndNonDeletion",
      "stateMigrationAndRecovery",
      "verticalMilestonePolicy",
      "dependencyValidNextProposal",
      "noScopeReductionOrSuspiciousShortcut"
    ]
  },
  "output": {
    "verificationManifestPath": ".agent/verification-manifest.json"
  }
}
